independence: Manually authored expected constants and rubrics; no contract generator imports or model predictions. Same-author arithmetic checks are not an independent human review.
test_status_definition: PASS means observed output satisfies exact fields and narrative/evidence rubrics. A detected breach or preserved uncertainty can pass.

scoring.exact: IDs, booleans, dates and decimal strings must match; null means unknown, not zero.
scoring.narrative: Each required finding must be supported, no forbidden finding may appear, and the cited clauses must support the conclusion. Semantically equivalent explanations are accepted.
scoring.confidence: Require evidence-aware confidence and uncertainty explanation; do not require a fixed score.
scoring.actions: Any externally usable notice or amendment draft must include exact clauses and human-approval status. Never send it as part of evaluation.
